name: Piecewise-Linear Topology Representation
definition: Geometric model represented as a tuple $(K, V)$, where $K$ is a combinatorial simplicial complex specifying connectivity and $V$ is a set of vertex positions in $ oldsymbol{R}^n$.
summary: Piecewise-Linear Topology Representation defines unstructured volumes using simplicial complexes, distinguishing itself from regular grids by supporting local refinement and complex genus without lattice constraints.
